explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration establishing irreducibility from the value being exactly one valuation step for an element of a valuation integer ring. The related `IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer` characterizes irreducibles by generation of the maximal ideal, which does not yield this result in one or two short lines. I also searched the valuation-integer irreducibility lemmas and found only the converse direction (an irreducible has value less than one).
